options.text: Yes — the camphor reacts with oxygen and produces heat and light.
No — any bright change is combustion even when oxygen is not involved.
No — heat alone is enough to call a change combustion, with no reaction with oxygen.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Kiran burns a small piece of camphor in air. It reacts and produces a flame with heat and light.

part_answers.answer: Combustion needs reaction with oxygen and production of heat or light; both are present here.

teacher.key_rationale: Combustion is a reaction with oxygen that produces heat or light. Burning camphor in air meets both checks.
